trigger: The simultaneous Wilson grid found no familywise signal, but Wilson intervals are approximate. This follow-up uses exact binomial intervals for Monte Carlo coverage rates.
monte_carlo_interval_method: Clopper-Pearson exact binomial interval for the repeated-simulation target interval coverage proportion
multiplicity: Bonferroni across five fixed effect sizes. Each marginal exact interval has coverage at least 99%; the union bound gives simultaneous familywise coverage at least 95% under independent simulation repetitions.
target_estimator: Unchanged household difference-in-means with two-sided Welch 95% target intervals.
dgp: Unchanged Bernoulli household return DGP from backend/app/analysis/workbench.py.

decision_rule.any_exact_simultaneous_interval_excludes: Evidence of an off-nominal target-interval coverage point in this specified synthetic DGP; preserve the estimator and investigate a separate method study.
decision_rule.all_exact_simultaneous_intervals_include: No familywise signal detected; this is not proof of calibration.

prohibited_changes: Do not reuse baseline or prior follow-up seeds.
Do not change the DGP, sample size, effect grid, target estimator, target interval, or primary effect after observing this study.
Do not describe these exact Monte Carlo intervals as making the target Welch interval itself exact.
